entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help me. I need to make a return for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I just bought. I'm just so disappointed, I really thought this would work for me.

I'm sorry to hear that you're disappointed with the product. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just a preference... it doesn't feel right on my ankle. Honestly, I really needed this money back for some other things. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I tried to do the return online yesterday, but there must have been a big website error.
I see. I understand completely. And you said the website wasn't working for you yesterday? Can I get your order number to look into this?

Yes, it's VF91288. The whole system seemed to be down. I kept getting an error page, so I couldn't print the return label. It was so stressful. I even took a screenshot because I was worried I'd miss my chance to return it.
Thank you for that order number and the information. I'm pulling up your details now... Okay, I see the order was delivered about ten days ago.

You have nothing to worry about. I'm checking our company policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. The website issue is frustrating, but it doesn't affect your eligibility at all.
Oh, it's 10 days? I thought it was shorter. That's such a relief. So I can still return it?

Yes, absolutely. I can process that return for you right now. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on file. You can just pack the sensor back in its original box and use that label.
Wow. Thank you so much, Diana. You've really helped me out. I was so worried. I really appreciate this.

You're very welcome. We want to make sure our customers are taken care of. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
